data.question_title: If \(n(A) = 5\) and \(n(B) = 8\), the maximum and minimum value of \(n(A \cap B) \) are:
data.explanation_txt:
Note that:

\(n(A \cap B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cup B) \)

So, \(n(A \cap B) =13 - n(A \cup B) \)

For maximum value of \(n(A \cap B) \), \(n (A \cup B) \) should be minimum. Since the union should contain all elements of both sets, the least value it can take is the GREATEST of the two cardinals, \(n(A)\) and \(n(B)\). In this case, this value is \(n(B) = 8\). So, the maximum value of intersection is \(13-8 = 5\)

Similarly for minimum intersection and maximum union, the sets are disjoint. So, the minimum value is 0.

So, \(A^{-1} = \left[ \begin{matrix} -4 & 1 \\ 2.5 & -0.5 \end{matrix} \right] \)

And \(X = \left[ \begin{matrix} -4 & 1 \\ 2.5 & -0.5 \end{matrix} \right] \left[ \begin{matrix} 3 & 0 \\ -5 & 6 \end{matrix} \right] = \left[ \begin{matrix} -17 & 6 \\ 10 & -3 \end{matrix} \right] \)

Many folk cures which have been around for centuries may be more therapeutic than previously suspected. A case in point is that of penicillin. Alexander Fleming did not just randomly choose cheese molds to study when he discovered these very important bacteria –killing substances. Moldy cheese was frequently given to patients as a remedy for illness at one time. Fleming just isolated what it was about the cheese which cured the patients.

In parts of South America, a powder obtained from grinding sugar cane is used for heating infections in wounds and ulcers. This usage may date back to pre-Columbian times. Experiments carried out on several hundred patients indicate that ordinary sugar in high concentration is lethal to bacteria. Its suction effect eliminates dead cells, and it generates a glass like layer which protects the wound and ensures healing.

Another example of folk medicine which scientists are investigation is that of Arab fishermen who rub their wounds production of glue like material that aids healing.

This catfish excretes a gel like slime which scientists have found to contain antibiotics, coagulant that helps close injured blood vessels, anti inflammatory agents, and a chemical that directs production of a glue like material that aids healing.

It is hoped that by documenting these folk remedies and experimenting to see if results are indeed beneficial, an analysis of the substances can be made, and synthetic substances can be developed for human consumption.
